headline: EagleRock Expands Midland Basin Footprint with New Dedication
summary: EagleRock announced an expansion of its Midland Basin footprint with a new acreage dedication.
why: EagleRock operates in US onshore oil and gas basins, where acreage additions signal growth in drilling inventory.

impacts.name: EagleRock
impacts.why: Expanding basin footprint supports future exploration and production capacity.
